description: A low-grade type of eczema or dermatitis mainly seen in children, characterised by pale hypopigmented patches with fine scale.
causes: Often coexists with dry skin or atopic dermatitis

appearance.general: Round, oval, or irregular pale patches or thin plaques, commonly on the face; fine scale may be present.
appearance.dark_skin: Hypopigmentation is more prominent, and the condition may be more common, in dark skin.
